batches.name: Onboard — chybějící hero plochy
batches.brief: Pět stránek 3.3 onboardu dnes nemá žádný hero (jen text): /roadmap, /team, /ai-native, /status, /contact. Všechny jsou 16:9, text vlevo (tmavá levá třetina), stejná malba jako ostatní hero plochy.

batches.name: Novinky — hero pro články
batches.brief: Přehled /news má nové hero (dodáno 17. 11.). Články samotné nemají hero kromě vánoční edice — chybí čtyři: Engine B, Mainnet Beta, odložený launch, interní audit.

batches.name: Těžba — pásy do utilitních stránek
batches.brief: Tabulkové stránky /mine/* nepotřebují velký hero, ale úzký pás nad obsahem (3:1). Drží vizuální kontinuitu, aniž by vytlačil data pod fold.

assets.alt_cs: Navigátorská komora za soumraku: na dřevěném stole rozložený plán letu, mosazná kružítka, dřevěné modely lodí jako milníky a jedna jantarová lucerna.
assets.alt_en: A navigator's chart room at dusk: a flight plan unrolled on a wooden table, brass dividers, carved ship models as milestones and one amber lantern.
assets.prompt: A navigator's chart room at dusk: a large parchment flight plan unrolled across a worn wooden table, brass dividers, a compass and small carved wooden ship models marking stages along the route; a steward's hand rests on the plan. One amber lantern lights the chart, deep ink shadows around, a calm window on the right showing a grey-blue sea and a distant coastline. Painterly manga brushwork, parchment and amber accents, rust-red cloth detail. The left third stays dark and uncluttered for text. No lettering on the plan, no labels, no numbers.

assets.alt_cs: Kulatý stůl v lucernami osvětlené síni: správce s klíči, řemeslnice s dláty a archivářka s knihou; nad stolem se vznáší malá zlatá koule světla.
assets.alt_en: A round table in a lantern-lit hall: a steward with keys, a craftswoman with chisels and an archivist with a book; a small golden sphere of light hovers above the table.
assets.prompt: A round oak table in a lantern-lit timber hall: three travellers seated — an older steward with a ring of iron keys, a craftswoman with chisels and a leather apron, a young archivist holding a closed book — and above the table a small calm golden sphere of light with fine luminous filaments (an AI presence, not a human, no face, no body). Warm amber lanterns hang from beams, the left side of the hall falls into deep ink shadow, one window shows a night sky. Respectful, human-scaled, painterly manga. Left third dark and clear for text. No text, no banners, no crests with lettering.

assets.alt_cs: Noční observatoř-knihovna: regály knih, mosazné orrery a nad stolem klidná zlatá koule světla s jemnými vlákny; u stolu píše sedící postava.
assets.alt_en: A night observatory library: bookshelves, a brass orrery and above the table a calm golden sphere of light with fine filaments; a seated figure is writing.
assets.prompt: An observatory library at night: tall shelves of worn books, a brass orrery on a side table, arched windows with stars, and above the central desk a calm golden sphere of light with delicate luminous filaments radiating like a geometric mandala (Hiran — a sphere of light, never a human figure, no face). A seated traveller writes by hand in a ledger, an amber lantern on the desk answers the sphere's glow. Painterly manga, ink depth, one warm focal light, cool night blues. Left third dark and clear for text. No text on the spines or the ledger, no UI, no screens.

assets.alt_cs: Kamenná hlásná věž na útesu za modré hodiny, lucerna na vrcholu svítí; pod ní řada signálních lamp — tři svítí, jedna zhaslá.
assets.alt_en: A stone beacon tower on a cliff at blue hour, its lantern lit; below it a row of signal lamps — three burning, one dark.
assets.prompt: A stone beacon tower on a sea cliff at blue hour: the tower's lantern room brightly lit, a soft amber beam across calm water, gulls, weathered ropes and a small wooden stair. On the terrace below, a row of four iron signal lamps — three burning amber, one dark and cold. A single keeper's silhouette checks the lamps. Painterly manga, cold marine blues against warm lantern light, rust-red banner cloth without lettering. Left third dark and clear for text. No gauges with numbers, no screens, no lettering.

assets.alt_cs: Psací stůl u otevřeného okna za soumraku: rozepsaný dopis, pečetní vosk a brk, hrnek, jantarová lucerna a výhled na moře s uvázanou lodí.
assets.alt_en: A writing desk by an open window at dusk: a half-written letter, sealing wax and a quill, a cup, an amber lantern and a view of the sea with a moored boat.
assets.prompt: A writing desk by an open window at dusk: a half-written letter on parchment (abstract pen strokes, no readable words), a stick of sealing wax, a brass seal and a quill in an inkwell, a ceramic cup with steam, an amber lantern. Beyond the window a quiet bay with one moored wooden boat and the last warm light on the water. Painterly manga, warm interior against cool evening sea, rust cloth over the chair back. Left third dark and clear for text. No readable writing, no addresses, no logos.

assets.alt_cs: Tiskařská dílna: na šňůře visí čerstvé malované listy, na stole barvy v pěti odstínech enginu B, štětce a jantarová lampa.
assets.alt_en: A printmaker's workshop: fresh painted pages hang on a line, five colour pots of the Engine B palette on the bench, brushes and an amber lamp.
assets.prompt: A printmaker's workshop at night: freshly pulled pages hang on a line across the room, each showing an abstract painted silhouette (mountains, ships, a lantern) with no lettering; on the workbench five shallow pots hold the palette — ink, forest green, parchment cream, amber, rust red — beside brushes, a cutting knife and an amber lamp. Warm light from one side, deep ink shadows, painterly manga. Left third dark and clear for text. No readable type, no logos, no UI.

assets.alt_cs: Pracovní přístav za prvního světla: naložená dřevěná loď, bedny a lana na mole, malá dívka s lucernou přihlíží, nad obzorem jedna jantarová hvězda.
assets.alt_en: A working harbour at first light: a loaded wooden ship, crates and ropes on the pier, a small girl with a lantern watching, one amber star above the horizon.
assets.prompt: A working harbour at first light: a sturdy wooden sailing ship taking cargo, crates and coiled ropes on the pier, dockhands carrying a chest, a small girl with light golden hair in a pink-gold cloak holding a wooden lantern (Lumi, a child — never an adult), watching the loading. One amber star low above the horizon, calm water, morning haze. Painterly manga, warm amber against cool dawn blues. Left third dark and clear for text. No lettering on crates or sails, no flags with logos.

assets.alt_cs: Loď na kotvě v tichém zálivu pod šedomodrým nebem, sbalené plachty, na přídi svítí lucerna; část posádky čeká na břehu s nářadím.
assets.alt_en: A ship at anchor in a quiet bay under a grey-blue sky, sails furled, a lantern burning at the bow; part of the crew waits ashore with tools.
assets.prompt: A ship at anchor in a quiet bay under a grey-blue overcast sky: sails furled and tied, a single lantern burning at the bow, gulls on the water. On the shore a few crew members sit on crates with tools and rope, waiting without drama — one mends a net, another sharpens a blade. Muted palette, ink shadows, one warm amber accent. Painterly manga, calm and honest, not sad, not dramatic. Left third dark and clear for text. No lettering, no logos, no flags with symbols.

assets.alt_cs: Stůl auditora při svíčce: otevřený rejstřík s abstraktními značkami, pečetěné svitky, mosazná lupa a nůž přeřezávající provaz.
assets.alt_en: An auditor's table by candlelight: an open ledger with abstract marks, sealed scrolls, a brass magnifier and a knife cutting a cord.
assets.prompt: An auditor's table by candle and lantern light: an open ledger with abstract tally marks and small diagrams (no readable words), three wax-sealed scrolls, a brass magnifying lens, a small knife slicing a bound cord, ink pot and a folded letter. Deep ink shadows, warm focused light, parchment and rust tones. Painterly manga, serious and calm, no drama. Left third dark and clear for text. No readable writing, no stamps with lettering, no logos.

assets.alt_cs: Řada vyřezaných dřevěných bloků u vchodu do dolu, jeden označený hvězdou, jantarové světlo lucerny.
assets.alt_en: A row of carved wooden blocks at a mine entrance, one marked with a star, amber lantern light.
assets.prompt: A low wide band: the mouth of a timber mine, a row of carved wooden blocks stacked on a cart, one block marked with a five-pointed star cut into the wood, an amber lantern hanging from a beam, dust in the light, dark gallery behind. Painterly manga, warm amber against deep ink. Horizontal composition, subject on the right, left third dark and clear for text. No numbers, no lettering.

assets.alt_cs: Dlaň předává malý plátěný váček přes dřevěnou lavici, vedle stojí mosazné váhy a lucerna.
assets.alt_en: A hand passes a small cloth pouch across a wooden bench, brass scales and a lantern beside it.
assets.prompt: A low wide band: a craftswoman's hand passing a small tied cloth pouch across a worn wooden bench to a miner's open palm, brass scales and a stack of payment tokens beside them, an amber lantern at the edge, ink shadows behind. Painterly manga, warm focused light. Subject on the right, left third dark and clear for text. No numbers, no coins with logos, no lettering.

assets.alt_cs: Tři siluety horníků u pracovního stolu v galerii, za nimi větráky a jantarové světlo.
assets.alt_en: Three silhouetted miners at a workbench in a gallery, fans behind them and amber light.
assets.prompt: A low wide band: three miners in silhouette at a long workbench inside a timbered gallery, hand tools and baskets of ore on the bench, two large ventilation fans turning behind them, amber lantern light scattering dust. Painterly manga, deep ink shadows, one warm light source. Figures on the right, left third dark and clear for text. No lettering, no brand marks on tools.

assets.alt_cs: Mosazné počítadlo a křídová břidlicová tabulka s abstraktními črtami vedle lucerny.
assets.alt_en: A brass abacus and a chalk slate with abstract figures beside a lantern.
assets.prompt: A low wide band: a brass abacus with worn beads and a dark slate with abstract chalk diagrams (lines and shapes, no readable numbers) leaning against a wall, an amber lantern beside them, a folded note and a stub of chalk on the bench. Painterly manga, warm light, ink shadows. Objects on the right, left third dark and clear for text. No readable numbers or words.

assets.alt_cs: Kontrolní galerie s řadou lamp: tři hoří jantarově, jedna je zhasnutá; ruka dohlížitele na páce.
assets.alt_en: A control gallery with a row of lamps: three burn amber, one is dark; an overseer's hand on a lever.
assets.prompt: A low wide band: an overseer's control gallery above a mine shaft, a rack of five iron signal lamps — three burning amber, one dark, one half-lit — with an overseer's hand resting on a brass lever, ropes and pulleys behind, warm light and dust. Painterly manga, deep ink shadows, one warm source. Lamps on the right, left third dark and clear for text. No dials with numbers, no lettering.

assets.alt_cs: Rozcestí v důlní chodbě: tři dřevěné ukazatele bez nápisů, lucerna na trámu a stopy v prachu.
assets.alt_en: A fork in a mine corridor: three wooden signposts without lettering, a lantern on a beam and footprints in the dust.
assets.prompt: A low wide band: a fork in a timbered mine corridor with three carved wooden signposts pointing different ways, their boards left blank (no lettering), an amber lantern hanging from a beam, footprints and a dropped glove in the dust. Painterly manga, warm amber against ink darkness, depth into the gallery. Posts on the right, left third dark and clear for text. No letters or symbols that read as words.
